Legs are 0.18 frame-widths thick and connect upward to the frame. Width/depth is 2.10; height/horizontal-span is 0.52. The supports occupy four separated corner positions. Leg-gap/width is 0.76. Across 4 opaque colors, the arms is mainly blue-gray and the cushions is cream. There are 2 seat cushions. Front and side views expose contours and attachment joins; top and oblique views reveal spacing and upper surfaces. Use colored voxels at unique integer coordinates from 0 through 47, with X left to right, Y upward and Z front to back. Real ground contact starts at Y zero. Use 750 through 1250 occupied voxels and integer RGB values from 0 through 255. Keep one six neighbor component, real openings and face connected parts. Add no display base, text, background, noise or floating ornaments.
